name: tell strength
verbal: by the drake reveal thine strength''
description: this reveals to the wizard the resistance level of the target with respect to bronze magic.  the response that the wizard receives is the number of stackable runes that would need to be cast on the target in order for a stackable spell to work.  see silver 'tell strength' for further details.

name: limb thrall
verbal: fool, feel the might of true power.....limb thrall
description: this is a level-based stackable spell, with resistances applying as listed under the tell strength spell listed above.  all other effects of the spell are as the spell thrall below but it applies to only one limb at a time.  the casting wizard may have more than one limb thrall active at a time.
note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)

name: shudder
verbal: fool, feel your mortal form twist and shudder under my power''
description: the target of the spell suffers a drop in dexterity armour class of 3 points, caused by uncontrollable shakes.  this can negate physical armour class, but will not drop the total armour class below 0.  if this is cast on a monster then it decreases the monsters hits by 6.  the minimum number of hits that a monster can be left with is 1, as clearly this spell cannot kill, but merely increase the amount of damage that the victim receives during combat. this spell does not stack with itself. immunity to dexterity drain or domination effects applies.

name: thrall
verbal: by the might of the bronze drake i am now your master and ye shall follow my commands.....thrall 4 levels'
description: this is a stackable spell, similar to sleep, but the target comes under the control of the casting wizard, becoming an unwilling automaton. the thrall will do nothing unless ordered to do so by the wizard, which includes defending themselves.  the target retains life/hit points and resistances as usual, but loses all weapon masteries, dexterity armour class and any skill that requires knowledge, which includes spell casting, or using mystical innates.  only psionics and other powers that may be triggered without any exterior motion or verbals can be used at the will of the victim.  the victim can be ordered to commit suicide, but it must beat itself to death using its own strength.  a thrall victim automatically develops the unarmed combat ability and may use any strength abilities that it may have.  also, they are not penalised for actions committed whilst under the influence of the spell - i.e. a priest drawing blood has no side effects. should the casting wizard of the thrall die; the spell is broken - as it is should the caster lose consciousness.
note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)
expertise: may cast thrall for 5mana per rune, with the 1st rune affecting 5 levels.

name: words of pain
verbal: hear now my words of pain.....''
description: the target stands or falls writhing in agony, unable to make any other action unless struck by another blow or spell.  during this period the target takes 6 tblp damage and 1 point to each location (2 hits to a monster) per 15 seconds, as long as the casting wizard stands talking to the target, up to a maximum of 5 minutes.  the damage ignores any form of armour class.  should the wizard elect to move around, stop talking or if the wizard takes damage or if the target takes any other damage then the spell is cancelled.  this spell does not effect creatures which do not feel pain, such as elementals, undead and the like.  this is not a listed stopping effect, and only complete immunity to pain effects can prevent the writhing detailed above.
expertise: may now cast this spell for 12 mana.

name: words of death
verbal: hear now my words of death.....''
description: as long as the wizard does not move from where they stand and they keep talking to the target then the target will suffer the effects of a magical disorder, which progresses at the following rate:	up to 1 minute:	they become too weak to move or cast, and collapse after 1 minute:	they are unconscious after 2 minutes:	they die this spell is broken if the wizard takes damage, casts another spell or moves from where he is standing, and then the mana is wasted.  the spell is not broken should the target be struck, however.  as this produces effects like a disease any creatures who are immune to disease are not affected by this spell.
expertise: expertise: may now cast this spell for 14 mana.

name: pain
verbal: by the ebony drake i smite thee with pain
description: the target of the spell is struck with a nerve wracking pain which causes a character 12 tblp damage (4 hits to a monster) - magical armour class does protect against this damage (at 1 for 1), and the damage is magical. only creatures vulnerable to pain are affected of course - undead and elementals, for example, are unharmed.

name: confusion
verbal: be thou filled with doubt and confusion'
description: this stackable spell causes a target affected to become unsure of what they are doing, they regard all around them as potential enemies, but will only initiate violence against those who attack them.  they will otherwise take no other action other than to defend themselves. this is a domination effect, not a stopping effect.
note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)
expertise: may now cast this spell for 3 mana per rune, and starting at 5 levels of effect.

name: spell shield
verbal: shield my body from magic, great ebony drake
description: this spell prevents any information spell working on the ebony wizard for the duration of the spell shield spell. this includes detect magic, but recognise mana will still give the normal responses.

name: induce spasm
verbal: by ebony power, let thy body wrack and spasm
description: this is a stackable spell, much like confusion, but the target will fall to the ground and writhe uncontrollably for the duration of the spell.  it is not a domination effect, but a listed stopping effect.
note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)
expertise: may now cast this spell for 5 mana per rune, and starting at 5 levels of effect.

name: pass unknown
verbal: may ebony power make my step unknown
description: the caster makes no noise (unless deliberate), nor can be smelled, granting invisibility to those two senses only- immunity to acute hearing and locational sniff.  it also prevents detection by mana sight and elemental sight, and other visual detections by creatures made by magic without minds e.g. statues, not elves. this spell is broken if the caster engages in melee combat (use of any weapon, including mp and hp ones).

name: mist
verbal: with ebony power let mist rise and hide me from my foes
description: the spell causes a thick mist to develop around the wizard, which moves as they do, maintaining a 10' radius around them.  whilst the casting wizard can see perfectly within the mist, no others can.  unintelligent creatures will not venture into the mist and those within the mist will try and leave it as swiftly as possible.

name: escape
verbal: ebony drake take me hence
description: this spell takes the wizard to any point that they had already been to during the course of the adventure, including the start point of the adventure.  this spell will not, however, cross planes, dimensions or any other mystical distances, and in all ways is treated as the blink spell. memorised locations may be learnt for 5pts each post 8th level, [cf. teleport].

name: mark ally
verbal: let our trust reside together''
description: this cantrip can only be cast upon a willing target and cannot be dispelled - the casting wizard must be told by the target if they refuse to accept the mark, thus making them an unwilling target.  this spell has several purposes.  firstly, certain spells can only be cast on a target who has been marked as an ally by the wizard; these spells are the beneficial other spells of the golden magic, and certain other golden spells contained in this supplement.  secondly, should a marked ally attack the wizard then they will suffer the reverse effect of any spell cast upon them by the golden wizard - this includes any spells cast prior or subsequent to the treachery. this spell may be cast on self if desired.

name: shield (self)
verbal: may the golden drake shield my body''
description: the caster receives an increase in their armour class of +2 magical armour class and +2 physical armour class.  this armour can stack with any other magical or physical defence, but not plate (self), plate (other) or other spells which preclude the stacking of armour.  it cannot stack with itself.

name: shield (other)
verbal: may the golden drake shield your body''
description: as shield (self), but this can only be cast on an ally, as described under the mark ally spell described above.
expertise: may be cast for only 2 mana on allies.

name: lesser forcewall
verbal: may the gold drake erect a shining wall of force.
description: creates a shimmering wall of gold force that is impenetrable to either magical or physical objects or beings.  this wall can be dissipated by use of the casting wizard's command word, as described under forcewall below.  the wall can be up to 20' high and 20' across, and must be a straight line.

name: strengthen (self)
verbal: feel the power through my limbs, the drake has strengthened my body to resist my foes''.
description: this increases the resistance level for the purposes of magical and physical effects for the wizard to 10 levels.  if the spell is cast after a level-based spell has already affected the wizard then the increase is only to 9 levels of resistance.  note, this does not stack with already raised increases in resistance - the increase is limited to 9 and 10.

name: hearten (self)
verbal: golden drake, strengthen my heart with your power''.
description: this spell temporarily grants immunity to all forms of non-spiritual domination, non-spiritual fear and non-spiritual paralysis.  if the caster is still mobile he may cast this spell after another spell has affected him - e.g. if he is not paralysed.

name: strengthen (other)
verbal: feel the power through your limbs, the drake has strengthened your body to resist your foes''
description: as strengthen (self), except that it works on those targets detailed under the mark ally spell.
expertise: may be cast for only 5 mana on allies.

name: hearten (other)
verbal: let the golden drake strengthen your heart with its power''
description: as the hearten (self) spell, except that it only works on those targets detailed under the mark ally spell.
expertise: may be cast for only 6 mana on allies.

name: warding
verbal: the golden drake wards your presence from me, foe''
description: this spell prevents one opponent with less than 9 levels of resistance, or 60 hits, from attacking the wizard, or from approaching within 10', forcing them to back away if need be.  the spell is broken if the wizard casts another spell, moves faster than a walk, attacks or the target is cornered and cannot get out of the 10' radius.

name: forcewall
verbal: golden drake, i beseech thee, erect a wall of force to protect my companions''
description: this creates a wall of force, which is purely magical, and will prevent any creature, which is not purely spiritual or completely immune to magic, from passing the wall.  it can be up to 30' long and 30' high, but must be in a straight line.  the wizard can elect to cancel it at any time, otherwise it can be released by use of a command word.  the same command word must always be used by the wizard and must be written on his character card.  the command word can be acquired by casting a talk to inanimate spell onto the force wall.  any who know the password may also lower the force wall. the ivory drake seeks to grant her followers might in magic, on the condition that they accept her own rules and conditions.  she is a lawful entity, and her code is to be adhered to by all her followers.  to break the code results in the loss of all ivory spells until the character has been atoned. this atonement either happens at the end of the adventure or at a time previous to that at the referees' discretion. - this applies to ivory draves equally. additionally any active ivory spells on the character immediately go down.

name: mark ally
verbal: let our trust reside together
description: this cantrip can only be cast upon a willing target and cannot be dispelled - the casting wizard must be told by the target if they refuse to accept the mark, thus making them an unwilling target.  this spell has several purposes.  firstly, certain spells can only be cast on a target who has been marked as an ally by the wizard; these spells are the beneficial other spells of the ivory magic, and certain other ivory spells contained in this supplement.  secondly, should a marked ally attack the wizard then they will suffer the reverse effect of any spell cast upon them by the ivory wizard - this includes any spells cast prior or subsequent to the treachery.
note: should the spell caster have access to gold and ivory magics it would be necessary for the target to receive two separate mark allies - in order to benefit from both colours. i.e. they are different and separate spells. mark ally may be cast on self if desired.

name: might (self)
verbal: may the drake give me strength
description: the caster gains +6/2 temporary life for the duration, which cannot be cured by spiritual means.  this spell will not stack with itself or any other temporary life-gains, except those from other ivory spells

name: might (other)
verbal: may the drake grant my ally strength to fight beside me
description: may only be cast on a marked ally. recipient gains +6/2 temporary life in all ways as might above, only while within 20' of the caster.  should the beneficiary leave this radius the benefits are lost until the radius is entered again.

name: traitors shield
verbal: may the ivory drake shield me from the acts of a traitor''
description: this spell only works if the wizard is attacked by a creature/character who previously on the adventure was marked as being an ally by the mark ally spell.  should that ally subsequently attack the wizard the wizard benefits as follows:1: armour class rises to the maximum armour class of the wizard against attacks from the traitor - this means magical, physical and dexterity armour class. 2: the wizard gains 18 tblp and 3 life per location with respect to damage from the traitor, and the traitor only.  these extra life points cannot be cured by spiritual means.

name: freedom of the drake
verbal: i have the strength of my drake
description: in most ways as the published ability war-cry - if used within 2 seconds of a listed stopping effect allows the caster to shrug it off and continue to act normally, and furthermore the caster becomes immune to that stopping effect for a further 5 minutes.  however, this spell may not be used against spiritual or 'mantic stopping effects, except by elves or draves.

name: mobility
verbal: may the ivory drake grant me great purpose in my actions''
description: the wizard cannot, for the duration of the spell, suffer from the effects of the following spells: bind, entangle, magnetise, freeze (white glyph only), trip, slip, catalepsy, sleep, slow, spells which repel the wizard, magical petrification or similar magical stopping/slowing effects.  neither are they affected by physical effects that would mimic the above, such as knockbacks or knockdowns.

name: ivory warrior
verbal: may the ivory drake grant me the might of her champion, let the power enter my form and strengthen my purpose to that of x men''
description: each glyph that the wizard activates on himself at the time of casting strengthens them, turning them into a mighty war machine.  for each additional glyph the verbal changes to granting the power of 3, 4 or more men.  once the spell has been cast it cannot be added to until the previous spell expires.  as with all stackable spells each glyph must be dispelled, and until all glyphs have been dispelled the spell remains at full potency. each additional glyph adds +6/+2 life points, +1 maximum armour class (up to a maximum armour class of 12) and 1 point of dexterity armour class. none of the additional life points may be spiritually cured.  the life from this spell is non-stacking with other temporary life-increases except those granted by other ivory spells.
note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8), not more than 6 runes may be benefited from at any one time.
expertise: may now cast this spell for 7 mana for the 1st rune, and 6 mana for each additional rune.

name: enhance weapon
verbal: ivory drake, twist and transform this wizard’s weapon such that my opponents will fear it's blow''
description: this spell will magically augment a traditional wizard’s weapon i.e. staff, spear or dagger.  the weapon can only be used by the wizard who cast the spell, and they cannot be physically disarmed, although a vanish will remove the weapon for 5 minutes.  the weapon is modified as follows:1: the weapon does 3 more magical damage grades, (i.e.+3 magical damage) stopping at the wizards maximum damage, normally, the maximum is quad. 2: the damage done ignores physical armour - only magical and dexterity armour can be used in defence against it. 3: the weapon will shatter any normal weapon, shield or armour used in defence against it.  it does not shatter anything else. if cast by a warlock (only) this spell will enhance any weapon instead of the above weapon types, if so desired.

name: sanctuary
verbal: the ivory drake offers shelter to all her allies who seek rest and shelter within the boundaries of her sanctuary''
description: within the range of the spell all marked allies of the wizard receive the following bonuses:1: +2 dexterity armour class.  this acts as the chosen of the dragon ability in the post 8th development system supplement.  this means that the +2 dac does not stack with blesses, curses or similar watchings.  2: 25% reduction of non-purely spiritual damage after armour calculations. this is as the cold rage ability (again, this can found in the post 8th level development system), and does not stack with any other percentile reductions of damage. 3: 9th level of resistance to magical attacks - this does not stack with any other resistance level increases.
note: the spell cannot be moved in any way, and no bonuses are gained unless the casting wizard is within the radius.
expertise: a silver wizard may repeat any published informational silver glyph they have cast, within the last minute at normal cost, again for 4 mana less. minimum 1 mana.  this can be used at most 1 per 15 minutes. this reduction is not cumulative with any other mana cost reduction. the spell must be used there and then it cannot be stored, or held over in anyway. all of these spells are obviously magical informational spells.

name: tell strength
verbal: by the dragon reveal thine strength
description: this reveals to the wizard the resistance level of the target with respect to silver magic.  the response that the wizard receives is the number of stackable runes that would need to be cast on the target in order for a stackable spell to work. 1 stackable rune	4th level	2 stackable runes	5th level	 3 stackable runes	6th level	4 stackable runes	7th level	 5 stackable runes	8th level	each additional rune	+1 level	 for example, tell strength on a 5th level player character would result in the response being `2 stackable runes'.

name: tell power
verbal: the silver dragon desires knowledge of your power''
description: this tells the caster what mana points and colours of mana are currently active on the target, but not what the actual spells are.

name: tell colour
verbal: the silver dragon desires knowledge of your colour''
description: this tells the caster the colour of either a spell that they can see the on-going effects of, or the colour of another wizard, warlock, power master or any other type of magician who uses either innate power points or innate spells.  if the target possesses more than one colour, knowledge is granted of all colours.

name: tell wounds
verbal: the silver dragon desires knowledge of your wounds''
description: this acts in all manners as the priestly discern nature of wounds ability.  however, this spell will only work on either elves or similar magical creatures or on the wizard who cast it.

name: tell form
verbal: tell me your form''
description: this tells the wizard the species of the target (e.g. human, troll, 1/2-orc, undead, wood elf or statue).  note that this spell will not differentiate between different types of the same species.

name: tell tracks
verbal: silver dragon, what has passed here?''
description: this spell grants the caster the skills tracking and shadowing for the duration, except that the caster has no need to keep a track list as would a ranger, as the silver drake has prior knowledge of all forms.

name: inquiry
verbal: elements, answer me this…
description: this allows the wizard to ask one question of all of the surrounding elements of air, earth, fire, water, light and darkness.  the elements collectively answer with a phrase of up to 3 words.  the subject of the question must be within 20' and the elements are only aware of events that have occurred in their presence.

name: true sight
verbal: silver dragon, remove all deceptions from my sight''
description: the caster is no longer affected by illusions and can see them for what they are.  the wizard can see magically or physically chameleoned, invisible or otherwise hidden objects - they are immune to all visual magic or physical deceptions, seeing through disguises instantly and so on. this spell is however an infomational spell - and immunity to informational spells stops it working on that individual.

name: know foe
verbal: the silver dragon demands knowledge of thee, foe''
description: the caster sets up a link between themselves and a target creature.  the wizard receives a bonus of 4 points of dexterity armour class with respect to damage from the target, and gains a non-cumulative weapon mastery in any physical weapon, or weapon created by mana, used by the wizard.  the target is unable to use any attack mode against the wizard bar a weapon, and may not use any special attack modes bar from the innate nature of the weapon.  for instance, a target warlock could continue to use their magic sword, but they could not cast a lightning bolt, nor could they use the shock spell that their sword could otherwise use once per day.   note, the benefits are the game effects of the casting wizard deducing all magical information about the target - no other information is to be given to the wizard. in order to cast a jade spell a person must be of goodly alignment, as such only goodly people may learn them as specialists.

name: reveal living
verbal: i call upon the powers of the body and the flesh to reveal to me if life may be found... reveal living
description: reveals if a target is living for the purposes of jade/onyx magic

name: strength within
verbal: may the life within grow strong and verdant power endure
description: grants the recipient 12 points of casting stamina for the duration, does not stack with itself.

name: strengthen the body
verbal: let verdant force strengthen your body
description: grants the recipient immunity to bruising using pac, dac, and/or mac.

name: revive the body
verbal: let the power of the verdant dragon flow into your body. where it has given way to harm let it rise again, where it has faded due to weakness let it grow strong. let jade power revive your body.
description: returns an individual to consciousness for the duration if they are unconscious due to damage. also ensures all limbs work for the duration if they are not working due to damage.

name: empower form
verbal: may verdant power flow through your body and empower your form
description: grants the recipient +18/6 life temp life. does not stack with other supernatural temp life, including itself.

name: eternal life
verbal: let verdant power renew your form
description: grants the target immunity to aging.

name: renew the body
verbal: may verdant power touch your form, let the weakness that afflicts you fade and pass.
description: removes all on-going strength and dex drains from the recipient. this does not remove spiritual effects.
expertise: if cast on a target that is not suffering from a strength or dex drain then the spell can instead grant them immunity to those effects for 5 minutes.

name: fortitude
verbal: may your blood cease to flow, your heart cease to beat, your lungs cease to draw breath, and your body be as magic as verdant magic sustains they life.
description: grants the target immunity to flesh and blood effects (including pain)for the duration. for 15 minutes after the spell ends (even if dispelled or otherwise ended prematurely) they have ½ effect beneficial flesh and blood (including potions).
expertise: the spell no longer has the detrimental effects after it ends.

name: harden the body
verbal: let verdant power touch your body, where it was weak let it become strong.
description: grants the recipient 25% off all bar purely spirit damage.

name: purge the dracon corpus
verbal: feel the touch of the jade dragon as it purifies your body
description: removes all on going onyx spells from the target. in order to cast an onyx spell a person must be of evil alignment, as such only evil people may learn them as specialists.

name: reveal living
verbal: i call upon the powers of the body and the flesh to reveal to me if life may be found... reveal living
description: reveals if a target is living for the purposes of jade/onyx magic

name: nature of the child
verbal: let your reflex’s slow and wits fade as the onyx dragon twists your form
description: causes the target to lose x points of dac for the duration. this cannot reduce the target below 0 dac.
expertise: the spell costs 2 mana less to cast, to a minimum of 3 mana.
special: this spell costs 2 mana plus x (the amount of dac). i.e draining 6 dac would cost 8 mana, or 6 with expertise

name: decay the form
verbal: let your body fade away to nothing as the onyx dragon decays your form
description: reduces the targets maximum life by 6/2 (2 hits) per casting. this will stack with itself. immunity to diminish spirit applies.
expertise: the first decay the form on a target causes them to lose 12/4 life (4 hits).

name: frailty of age
verbal: the onyx dragon twists your body, let your muscles weaken and strength fade
description: causes the target to lose a grade of strength for the duration, to a minimum of zero.

name: rend the body
verbal: the onyx dragon rips through your flesh, severing muscles to rend the body
description: causes the target to suffer 24/4 damage to which mac does not apply. immunity to involuntary shape-shifting applies.

name: the body crumbles
verbal: your flesh is ruined, bones brittle and feels the might of the onyx drake as your body crumbles.
description: causes all published active onyx spells on the target to become 15 minute in duration.

name: wither
verbal: the onyx drake grips your .... let bones crumble and flesh wither
description: causes the target limb too become withered and unusable for the duration. the limb is still present and as such can suffer damage.

name: heart attack
verbal: the onyx dragon holds your heart in his claws, shudder and die now as they close... heart attack
description: causes the targets heart to cease to beat for a few seconds causing them to suffer 18 tblp, 18 to the chest (6 hits to a monsters) to which mac does not apply. additionally the target suffers a magical halt at the casters skill level. this is a flesh and blood effect, and immunity to flesh and blood effects applies.

name: weaken the body
description: causes the target to suffer 25% more damage from any magical attack. this applies vs pure weapon blows, but not those with a physical component. immunity to involuntary shape-shifting applies.

name: Empower Weapon
description: Makes one weapon of the caster's choice +0 magical and of the colour of the caster. If the caster has more than one wizardly colour they may buy this glyph more than once if desired. This weapon must be a normal non-supernatural weapon and cannot be further enhanced. The weapon is only magical while in the hands of the caster.

name: Pact with the Drake/Dragon
description: This stackable glyph will grant the caster a boon from his Dragon or Drake. This takes the form in game terms equivalent to the innate powers granted to the Elves/Draves of the respective Dragon/Drake. The first rune grants 4 levels of elven innates, each additional rune will grant +1 level of innates. Thus 5 runes will grant 8th level magical innates. Whilst active the caster may not recover the mana spent on this spell, without it ending the Pact early.

name: Empower Weapon
description: Makes one weapon of the caster's choice +0 magical and of the colour of the caster. If the caster has more than one wizardly colour they may buy this glyph more than once if desired. This weapon must be a normal non-supernatural weapon and cannot be further enhanced. The weapon is only magical while in the hands of the caster.

name: Pact with the Drake/Dragon
description: This stackable glyph will grant the caster a boon from his Dragon or Drake. This takes the form in game terms equivalent to the innate powers granted to the Elves/Draves of the respective Dragon/Drake. The first rune grants 4 levels of elven innates, each additional rune will grant +1 level of innates. Thus 5 runes will grant 8th level magical innates. Whilst active the caster may not recover the mana spent on this spell, without it ending the Pact early.

name: Elemental Sight
description: Grants the caster elemental sight of the appropriate type. It should be noted that while this allows the caster to distinguish between three categories: 'own element', 'opposite element', and 'other elements', these elements remain pervious to vision (or not) as they would normally be.

name: Bind Elemental
description: Binds the power of a standard elemental to the current plane, so that its presence is more stable and it can utilise more of its elemental powers. The elemental is not disrupted by coming into contact with another elemental, cannot be embodied, cannot be destroyed with an elemental-destroying effect whilst this glyph is active, may carry enchanted objects, is immune to offensive effects/attacks based upon its own element, and gains additional powers based upon its native element.

name: Elemental Warding
description: Grants the caster 50% off all damage from attacks from the element of opposite colour. The reduction applies only to damage, not other effects, and only against magical attacks of the opposite colour.

name: Arm Elemental
description: This spell transforms an elemental slightly such that its hands become either a one-handed sword or mace, increasing the damage inflicted by 6 points, to a maximum of 24 points. This spell transforms both of the elemental's hands simultaneously and physical reps must be used.

name: Elemental Shift
description: This spell transports the wizard from a spot immersed in the appropriate element to another similar point that the caster can see or is within 20'. It may only be used for elements that the Wizard holds as a colour. There is a 2 second period of disorientation on arrival exactly as per the Standard 6mp Blue Glyph Blink.

name: Embody Elemental
description: The wizard may embody an elemental 6 of their own colour that they have just summoned. This grants the ability to shift at will as the appropriate elemental and the elemental sight possessed by the elemental. If the elemental is dispelled, destroyed or removed, the caster dies. If the Embody Elemental glyph is dispelled the Caster and Elemental die. If an elemental touches the wizard the wizard and the elemental vanish.

name: Aura of Defence
description: This causes any weapon to be affected by a spell appropriate to the colour of the wizard just before it strikes the caster. The spell may be Melt (Red), Rust (Green), Warp (Brown), Shatter (Blue), or Disintegrate (Black).

name: Mana Form
description: This spell causes the casters form to become embraced by their type of magic, causing their bodies to become only affected by magic. Physical barriers still block and impede the Wizard. Whilst this spell is active the caster may not benefit from, nor cast, any other colour of magic than the one used to power this spell. This spell may only be cast by wizards that are 'spiritless' AND magical creatures.

name: Elemental 'Port
description: This spell transports the wizard from a spot immersed in the appropriate element to another similar point on the same plane. The wizard must have seen the destination before on this adventure, have the destination within line of sight, live there, or have memorised the location. There is a 2 second period of disorientation on arrival. Casting damage for casting it a second time within a one hour period is calculated as if the glyph were three levels higher.

name: Summon Elemental 'Champion'
description: This spell conjures an elemental 'Champion' to be commanded. An elemental 'Champion' may take 40 hits before being destroyed, inflicts 15pts of damage with its hands and has 10th level Resistances. It will not be negated by being struck by a 4 or 6 mana elemental, only by an 8 mana or higher elemental.

name: Palewise's Reforge The Fallen Child
description: This acts as per a Restore Life miracle except it does not require a protection from spirits, functions regardless of alignment, will only function vs an elf, drave, faerie, or similar being that is harmed by Dispels that is the same racial colour as the spell, and must be cast within 20ft of their death, or over their body if they have one.

name: Mortality
description: One living target capable of perceiving fear is afflicted in a similar manner to the 4 spirit miracle Cause Fear, becoming terrified of the caster. However it lasts only one minute. Target must not be in Magical Light. Should they enter an area illuminated by Magical Light the spell is released.

name: Blindness
description: As per the Drowe innate ability. This is a stackable glyph.

name: Shadow Strike
description: One target takes 18 tblp of purely magical damage (6 Hits), to which MAC applies on a 1 for 1 basis. This spell does not affect those targets in Magical Light.

name: Kazak's Dark Binding
description: Binds a normal Shade 6 (which must have been under the caster's control) into a non-supernatural weapon. Weapon now inflicts +0 black mana damage and may be used to additionally cause Disintegrate (Touch) by blow. The shade bound into the weapon counts as a Shade 6 for dispelling/negating.

name: Ally Darkness
description: This spell grants the person it is cast upon the ability to see through magical darkness. Also any Darkness (R) cast upon the target moves with him whilst under the Ally Darkness spell.

name: Ki Black's Engulfing Touch
description: This spell covers the touched target in a magical shadow. They are held immobile as per a Magical Paralysis. It will end prematurely should the target be placed in Magical Light. The spell, once cast, will hang on the caster's hands for up to 5 seconds.

name: Shadow Plate
description: As per Plate (O) but actually only grants negative Magical Armour Class 5, to a minimum of zero MAC. This spell still grants the 5 points of non-cumulative physical armour class (PAC) normally accrued from use of the Plate (O) spell.

name: Dark Bolt
description: As the Standard 6mp Blue Glyph Lightning Bolt.

name: Sabre of Darkness and Deceit
description: This spell creates a sabre of pure darkness that does 12 points of pure magical damage. When used against any goodly aligned or light-based creature it additionally inflicts a 6/1 Blast. The wielder can also see through magical darkness. This spell is usable only by characters of evil alignment.

name: Shadowblade
description: Causes the weapon the spell is cast upon to lose its physical nature and become purely magical. This means that Physical Armour Class cannot be applied to blows from a weapon so affected – only Dexterity Armour Class and Magical Armour Class may.

name: Zandranas' Droplets of Death
description: One target within range is spattered with a droplet of magical venom from directly above. If they are wearing a helmet or similar the venom does not penetrate. Otherwise, the target suffers the effects of a Contact Venom 6, taking 30 seconds to take full effect as normal.

name: The Shadows Called
description: Causes the target to be covered in shadows. No matter where they travel they are within a Darkness spell, including the obscuring of vision. This only effects the target and not others around them.

name: Nysh'Aqal's Passing Plague
description: After 2 minutes, the target will feel ill and have noticeable feelings of nausea; and after 5 minutes this is heightened to the extent that they are deemed at the 5 minute stage of disease. This state lasts for 5 minutes, after which time the Plague passes away. Spiritless Drowe are curiously immune to the effects of this spell.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: May only be cast in an area of heavy shadow or darkness. While the caster remains in these conditions he becomes invisible to normal, physical sight. Should the caster touch a light source, enter an area which is lit by more than weak candlelight, run, attack or cast a spell, the spell is broken and he becomes visible.

name: Cateleptic Touch
description: Once cast, the wizard has 5 seconds to touch a target, which affects them as if they had suffered a Catalepsy spell at the caster's skill level. Note however the decreased duration of 30 seconds.

name: Blade of Decrepitude
description: This spell summons a bastard sword of negative energy, which unnaturally ages all those it strikes. Every blow struck by the Blade of Decrepitude reduces the target's current and maximum life (TBLP and Locations) by one level for an hour. The sword inflicts no other damage, and may only be used by the caster.

name: The Disintegration
description: All objects which can be disintegrated (Weapons, Armour, Shields, Potion Bottles, Treasure, Non supernatural paperwork) which are within line of sight and within 20' are disintegrated. This spell does not affect the casting wizard's possessions.

name: Sithantis' Ebon Tendrils
description: Surrounds the caster with a multitude of half-visible, weaving black tendrils of power. These have the effect of turning blows away from the caster, granting him +4 PAC and complete immunity to weapon blows from wielders using no weapon masteries. They will not however block any weapon blow without a physical component.

name: Disintegrate Magic
description: This spell acts as per the disintegrate range spell but functions vs any object that does not contain a spiritual component.

name: Greater Shadow Plate
description: This spell hangs on the caster's hands for 5 seconds after being cast. It grants the target non-stacking PAC 10 (in a similar manner to Plate Self), but reduces their MAC by 10 (to a minimum of 0) at the same time.

name: Steal Vitality
description: This spell causes the target to have all 'strength' drained from them. This spell hangs on the caster's hand for up to 5 seconds.

name: Void
description: One target currently within magical darkness is instantly swallowed up by darkness, vanishing completely to reappear in the same spot 5 minutes later. During this time the target finds themselves in a dark void, empty of all things.

name: Allstarz's Stomach Upset
description: May only be cast on an item of food or drink, at least the size of a bun or 500ml of liquid. Infuses the item with a magical venom, unnoticeable to normal poison detection abilities. If the item is entirely consumed by one victim within the duration of the spell, they suffer the effects of an Ingestive Death poison, dying unless immune to poison.

name: Anath's Annihilation
description: Once this spell is cast, the caster has 5 seconds to touch a target with both hands. The target is slain and their body disintegrated, requiring a Reform spell before they can be restored to life. Immunity to Involuntary Shape Shifting grants complete immunity.

name: Air Dart
description: Inflicts 6/1 magical lightning damage in the same manner as the Storm Blast spell. Causes 2 hits to monsters. This spell has a decreased range.

name: Summons
description: This spell requires the wizard to meditate whilst holding the object for 1 minute and then cast the spell, expending 2 mana for each time that he wishes to be able to summon the item. Later the wizard may call the item to his hand which must be held outstretched towards the object. The blink still requires a 2 second phase time. This spell is learnt as a 2 mana glyph.

name: Lightning Shock
description: Functions as the Red Spell Shock, except that the damage is blue magic lightning and Resistance to Lightning, not fire, applies.

name: Thunderous Decree
description: This spell causes a phrase of up to seven words spoken by the caster at the end of the verbal to be shouted with tremendous volume. All with Sensitive Hearing within 20' (including the caster) are stunned for 10 seconds, or until struck. This spell may be cast at most once every 15 minutes by the same caster.

name: Breeze
description: One target within 20' of the caster is pushed back 20' by the force of wind.

name: Skin of Air
description: The recipient of the spell is surrounded with a thin shell of pure air. This air is constantly replenished for the spell's duration, thus allowing the recipient to breathe, regardless of exterior interference. Non-supernatural gasses and liquids are completely displaced by this spell. However the spell is not capable of resisting forceful attacks.

name: Thunder Clap
description: This spell causes a sudden crack of thunder, centred on one target within hearing range who can be seen, stunning and deafening them. The target suffers the effects of a magical Halt spell of the 'skill level' of the caster, and is additionally deafened for 5 minutes.

name: Greater Telekinesis
description: As Telekinesis, but is considered to have 2 grades of strength for moving objects. Can only be used on inanimate objects, or completely motionless animate targets.

name: Cushion of Air
description: Creates a resistance in the air within the radius of the spell so that the wizard and any others in the area suffer no falling damage.

name: Gust of Wind
description: All those within a 60' cone and within 10' of the caster are thrown 20' back by the force of the wind created by this spell.

name: Forked Lightning
description: This causes two separate targets that are indicated, to be hit with a Lightning Bolt style effect. If only one target is within range then one of the bolts strikes the wizard. The same person may never be struck twice with the same single casting of this spell.

name: Thunderbolt
description: As Lightning Bolt but the damage is 36 TBLP and 6 per location (12 Hits to monsters).

name: Shatter Magic
description: As per Shatter but will affect objects with a magical component. Will not function on other supernatural objects such as spiritual weapons. Can be mended as normal by use of a Mend spell. Cannot be used on Wall spells or similar.

name: Mustrum's Instantaneous Blink
description: As per the basic Blue spell of Blink but with the above differences. The use of this spell causes the caster the loss of a casting level for the following hour.

name: Su's Mass Blink
description: This spell causes all those who are willing and touching the caster to be 'blinked' - as per the Blink spell. This spell costs 10 mana +1 per person affected. Casting damage is calculated as a 10th level spell plus 1tblp per additional person.

name: Plane Shift
description: Transports the caster to the corresponding point on a different plane 'of his choice', meaning that the caster must either have been previously to that plane, or have sufficient knowledge of it. This spell only transports the caster to the corresponding point on the plane of choice, not where he wishes to go.

name: Hurricane
description: This spell effectively creates a circular barrier at a distance of 10' from the caster, which is immobile. The barrier is opaque and impassable by any creature with a physical or magical form due to the incredible high speed of the winds spinning around the focal point.

name: Teleport
description: As 6 mana point Standard spell Blink in all manners except the range is anywhere on the wizard's current plane of existence, even if it is out of line of sight. The wizard must have seen the destination before on this adventure, have the destination within line of sight, live there, or have memorised the location. If this glyph is used twice within an hour, the stresses on the body are such that the caster takes casting damage as if the glyph were two levels higher.

name: The Shattering
description: All objects which can be shattered (Weapons, Armour, Shields, Potion Bottles, Treasure, Non supernatural paperwork) which are within line of sight and within 20' are shattered. This spell does not affect normal clothing, nor any of the casting wizard's possessions.

name: Storm Caller
description: This spell allows the caster to cast the Storm Blast spell at will for 0 mana for the duration. However, the caster takes 1tblp damage, which is unreduceable and unavoidable per casting. Full verbal for the Storm Blast spell must be used each time, and it may not be cast at a rate greater than 1/10 seconds. The casting of this spell causes the caster to lose one casting level for the next hour.

name: Displacement
description: Causes one object that does not contain a spirit to be shifted from its present location to the caster's hands.

name: Intelligent Dancing Sword
description: Exactly as the 8mp Handbook Blue Glyph Dancing Sword but the caster does not need to concentrate on the sword, although he is required to be able to view the blade at all times for it to be active. The damage delivered by the sword is 24 magic points rather than the 18 points usually delivered by a Dancing Sword.

name: Mass Plane Shift
description: As per Plane Shift but the wizard may take extra willing people with him at the additional cost of 1 mana point and 1 life point each.

name: Mass Teleport
description: As per Teleport but the wizard may take extra willing people with him at the additional cost of 1 mana point and 1 life point each.

name: George's Grand Banishment
description: The target touched with both hands within 5 seconds of reciting the spell is involuntarily Teleported away, and on reappearing in a random location is immediately re-Teleported before fully phasing in. This repeats for the full duration of the spell. Effectively any target not Immune to Involuntary Mystical Transportation spells is rendered completely unable to act or be affected by exterior sources for 24 hours.

name: George's Vacuum
description: The spell causes all the air in the targets lung to be drawn rapidly from them, causes extreme damage to their lungs. This acts as per a sever to the target's abdomen. This is a flesh and blood effect and does not work on most elves. It does work on air elves.

name: Involuntary Gesture
description: This simple spell causes the target to momentarily perform one otherwise inconsequential action. Such as twitching, slightly moving their foot, shrugging their shoulders, blinking or similar. The successful use of the spell will reveal whether the target is Immune to Bronze Mana Domination effects or not. This is a Domination Effect.

name: Power Word 'Trip'
description: This spell only affects the target if it has a resistance level lower than the wizard's skill level. The target will fall to the ground and be unable to rise for 2 seconds. This spell requires no object for the target to trip over. This is a Domination Effect.

name: Empower Voice
description: For the next Power Word spell used by the caster within the spell's duration, their skill level is considered to be one higher.

name: Power Word 'Fear'
description: This spell only affects the target if it has a resistance level lower than the wizard's skill level. Apart from where detailed above this spell is identical to the evil miracle Cause Fear. It is also a Domination Effect.

name: Vertigo
description: One target of below the caster's skill level feels the sick queasiness of vertigo whenever away from contact with the ground. As such they will not voluntarily use any form of flight power, and if lifted off the ground by another source they will perform no rational action other than to try to return to the ground. This is a Domination Effect.

name: Persuasive Suggestion
description: This spell acts in all ways as per a magical Beguile Spirit, except limited to only the command specified in the verbal, which may be no longer than 3 words. This spell affects targets that have a resistance level to Bronze Magic lower than the caster's skill level. This is a Domination Effect.

name: Power Word 'Die'
description: This spell affects a living target that is affected by magical effects. This spell causes the target to fall over unconscious as if dead until the end of the spell's duration or until struck. It is considered a listed stopping effect, and additionally a Domination effect. It will only work on creatures below the wizards skill level.

name: Power Word 'Awaken'
description: The target is 'awoken' from any magical or physical stopping effects that they may be suffering from. This is a Domination Effect and affects targets of less than the caster's skill level only.

name: Wracking Pain
description: This spell causes the target to be struck down with pain as per the Words of Pain spell, although the caster need not continue talking to maintain it. The target suffers 6/1 damage (2 hits) and can take no action other than writing on the floor in agony until the spell expires or they are struck or harmed. This is not a stopping effect.

name: Limb Stun
description: The nominated limb of the target is struck useless. If an arm, anything held in it is dropped. If a leg, the target cannot put weight on it for the duration of the spell. This is considered a Listed Stopping Effect.

name: Word of Command
description: This spell acts as per the miracle Voice of Power (except for the duration). It affects targets below the caster's skill level.

name: Darkness Ranged
description: creates a sphere of darkness 10ft radius in surrounding the point chosen (can move with a player)

name: Darkness Self
description: creates a sphere of darkness 10ft radius in surrounding the caster (this is static, does not move)
